insert_vectors_mariadb: insert vector embeddings into a MariaDB collection using MariaDBVectorClient insert method
upsert_vectors_mariadb: upsert vector embeddings into a MariaDB collection using MariaDBVectorClient upsert method
search_vectors_mariadb: search similar vectors in a MariaDB collection using cosine or euclidean distance
delete_vectors_mariadb: delete vectors from a MariaDB collection by id list or metadata filter
query_vectors_mariadb: query documents from a MariaDB collection by metadata filter without vector search
